marta: Quick question — can we prefetch auth/context headers at the edge and use them for routing decisions to avoid a second hop? thinking of cases where calling auth service for every request bumps p99.
raj: You mean fetch and attach a derived header like `X-Route-Assertion` before it hits the gateway router? risky for PII and replay unless signed.
kai: Exactly. Signed assertion + short TTL would work. Client or edge signs `X-Route-Assertion: alg=ed25519;sig=...;ttl=5s;ctx=customer:acme` then router verifies and routes locally.
marta: Sketching a tiny config: ```
matchers:
  - header: X-Route-Assertion
    verify: ed25519
    ttl_seconds: 5
    route: dedicated-pool
``` 
olivia: From UX side we need a console toggle for this rollout. Ops should be able to enable "edge assertions" per-env and see telemetry: %requests using assertion vs fallback, average verify latency, failed verifies.
sylvie: Quota question — if header is spoofed, we could misattribute usage. We should only honor signed assertion for quota/tagging when signature validated and the signer is a trusted issuer.
raj: +1. Add a telemetry flag on the route: `honor_signed_identity:true` which adds `identity_source=assertion_verified` to logs/metrics.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: routers/v2-edge-assertion-checkpoint canary -> 10% at 2026-03-21T12:40Z :rocket:
marta: Also thinking about metrics — we should emit a small histogram of verify latency and a counter for `assertion_verify_failures` with labels `reason=expired|bad_sig|malformed`.
kai: Another edge case — long streaming requests. We verify at start, but user-agent changes or midstream upgrades shouldn't re-eval. Mark stream as pinned to route after initial verify.
olivia: Console UX: show per-route breakdown: header-match rate, signed-assertion adoption, and estimated cost delta if routed to dedicated vs hosted. can we surface a quick "what-if": toggle signed assertion routing to simulate quota + latency impact on last 7d?
sylvie: For rollout plan: 1) add opt-in boolean on route config 2) emit telemetry 3) UI toggle + warn about billing attribution 4) gradual canary by tenant tag 5) enforce signed-only for quota attribution after safe threshold.
raj: Security note: ensure edge verifier does not retain raw tokens. verify and drop sensitive material; only keep non-PII identity tags.
marta: Ok I'll prepare a tiny RFC and a prototype patch for router verification lib. Will also add console mockups for the toggle + telemetry widgets. tagging @olivia for UX follow-up.
olivia: Got it, will sketch mock and link in RFC. :thumbsup:
